title: Understanding the gastrointestinal behavior of phytochemicals and antioxidants from araca-boi (Eugenia stipitata- McVaugh) extract: An in vitro and in silico approach.
authors: Borsoi, Felipe Tecchio; Arruda, Henrique Silvano; Reguengo, Livia Mateus; Neri Numa, Iramaia Angelica; Pastore, Glaucia Maria
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估植物提取物消化后的抗氧化活性，仅对次要化合物与炎症靶蛋白做分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the influence of gastrointestinal digestion on the phytochemical profile, phenolic compounds, antioxidant capacity, and sugar content in the araca-boi extract. Additionally, molecular docking of target proteins and ADMET analysis were performed using the major compound of araca-boi extract after gastrointestinal digestion. UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS analyses revealed 100 compounds identified, and after gastrointestinal digestion, only 59 compounds were identified. Gastrointestinal digestion had a significant impact on phenolic compounds and sugar content. The extract showed an increase in antioxidant capacity in the ABTS(*+) assay, while it decreased in the DPPH, FRAP, and ORAC assays after gastrointestinal digestion. The in silico study showed that trans-cinnamic acid interacts with target proteins such as NF-kappaB, IL-1beta, and PI3K and that it has a promising pharmacokinetic profile. These findings emphasize the importance of further investigating the effects of the extract in different physiological contexts and its potential applications.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估胃肠消化对阿拉卡博伊提取物中植物化学特征、酚类化合物、抗氧化能力及糖含量的影响。此外，利用阿拉卡博伊提取物经胃肠消化后的主要化合物进行了靶蛋白的分子对接 (molecular docking) 和ADMET分析。UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS分析鉴定出100种化合物，而经胃肠消化后仅鉴定出59种。胃肠消化对酚类化合物和糖含量有显著影响。在ABTS(*+) 试验中，提取物的抗氧化能力有所增加，而在DPPH、FRAP和ORAC试验中则有所下降。计算机模拟 (in silico) 研究表明，反式肉桂酸 (trans-cinnamic acid) 与NF-kappaB、IL-1beta和PI3K等靶蛋白相互作用，并具有前景良好的药代动力学特征。这些发现强调了进一步研究该提取物在不同生理环境中的效应及其潜在应用的重要性。
